name: prompt-enhancer
description: Rewrite a draft prompt or coding task into a clear, agent-ready brief before you send it. Returns one rewritten prompt; never runs the task.

interface.longDescription: Prompt Enhancer is an AI prompt enhancer and prompt optimizer for Codex and ChatGPT. It improves a rough prompt or coding task and gives it back as one clear, ready-to-send prompt. It never runs the task. It keeps your names, numbers, links, code and constraints exactly as written, adds only the guidance a vague draft is missing, and never invents facts or placeholders.
capabilities: Improve a rough prompt before you send it
Turn a vague coding task into an agent-ready brief
Optimize prompts without running the task
defaultPrompt: Improve this task before I give it to Codex: fix the crash when I click Save.
Rewrite this into a clear brief: add rate limiting to the API.
Improve this prompt before I send it: write a blog post about fitness.
